summary: Updated mopidy package fixes a security vulnerability
details:
Mopidy before 4.0.5 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows
unauthenticated clients to access local files outside file/media_dirs
because FileLibraryProvider.lookup() lacks a containment check.
Attackers can call core.library.lookup or core.tracklist.add over
JSON-RPC or WebSocket with file:// URIs to probe file existence, read
tag metadata, and play out-of-sandbox files.
